links.comparator_used: Identical medical advice labelled as from a "Human physician" (no AI label), compared with "AI" and "Human + AI" labels
links.outcome: Perceived reliability, perceived empathy and willingness to follow the advice
links.effect: AI-labelled and Human + AI-labelled advice was rated significantly less reliable and less empathetic than Human-labelled advice, and participants were less willing to follow it when AI was believed to be involved (two preregistered studies, N = 2,280; no numeric estimates in the abstract)
links.tradeoff: Labelling AI involvement produced an anti-AI bias, which persisted even when AI was described as supervised by physicians
links.quote: “AI” and “Human + AI”-labelled advice was evaluated as significantly less reliable and less empathetic compared to “Human”-labelled advice.

design_hint: disclosure of AI involvement / physician supervision label
